impact.text: any address can decide when the snapshot should be updated

precondition_sources.text: updatePrice() is permissionless, so any address can decide when the oracle snapshot is updated.

intent_sources.text: The oracle snapshot must not be steerable away from the original market price by an attacker controlling the pool spot regime and calling updatePrice() over time.
